title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 19:00 UTC on 27 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 27 日 19:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 19:00 UTC on 27 September. The 19:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 19:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.33/0P). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-27T17:36:00 UTC; label 1M). Published-window maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-09-27T14:38:00 UTC; label 1P). Window start 2026-09-27T14:38:00 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 20:00 UTC hour on 27 September is still incomplete (36 samples through 20:35).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (19:00 UTC on 27 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 19:00 UTC is 0.33/0P and the hour ends 0.33/0P at 19:59. The 20:00 UTC hour on 27 September is incomplete (36 samples through 20:35).
